# User Model

The User model represents a user in the system. Users can be created, read, updated, and deleted.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| id | int | The unique identifier of the user. |
| email | str | The email address of the user. |
| username | str | The username of the user. |
| password | str | The password of the user. |
| first_name | str | The first name of the user. |
| last_name | str | The last name of the user. |
| is_active | bool | Whether the user is active. |
| is_superuser | bool | Whether the user is a superuser. |
| date_joined | datetime | The date and time the user joined the system. |

## Methods

### create

```python
create(self, data)
```

Creates a new user with the given data.

#### Parameters

- `data` (dict): The data to create the user with.

#### Returns

- `User`: The created user.

#### Raises

- `AttributeError`: If the given data does not match the required format.

### read

```python
read(self, user_id)
```
